name: Dribble Drive
idea: Fake one way, then dribble hard the other way, right past your defender.
why: A quick fake makes your defender lean the wrong way. While they get their balance back, you are already gone.
tryit: Practice a jab step: a quick little step one way, then push off and dribble the other way with your eyes up.

frames.say: {1} has the ball at the top, and {X1} is guarding close. {2} waits in the corner to give {1} room.
*Fake:* {1} takes a quick step to the right. {X1} leans that way too.
*Drive:* Then {1} pushes off and dribbles hard the other way, right past {X1}.
{1} keeps dribbling all the way to the basket. {X1} is a step behind.
Layup! Fake one way, go the other way. That’s a dribble drive.
